unlisted_practices: Involve people with voice disorders in the development of AI-driven assistive products to ensure they meet their specific needs.
Use standardized data collection protocols for voice biomarker data so multiple entities can collect and share data effectively.
Use headset microphones at a consistent distance from the mouth, about three inches, for voice data collection in clinical studies.
Address audio variability across recording hardware and acoustic environments through wider data collection and data augmentation when deploying vocal biomarker models outside the lab.

screen.reason: Workshop summary and consensus/perspective paper reporting on best practices, standardization, ethics, and deployment considerations for voice AI in healthcare.
